# Overdispersion check

```{r}
#| label: Overdispersion

 # scaling of the variables

sampled_data_join_sf_scale <- sampled_data_join_sf %>% 
  mutate(annual_rainfall_2021    = as.numeric(scale(annual_rainfall_2021)),
         annual_temperature_2021 = as.numeric(scale(annual_temperature_2021)),
         pop_density_2020        = as.numeric(scale(pop_density_2020)),
         dist_to_water           = as.numeric(scale(dist_to_water)),
         elevation               = as.numeric(scale(elevation)),
         vegetation_index        = as.numeric(scale(vegetation_index)),
         lc_water                = as.numeric(scale(lc_water)),
         lc_built                = as.numeric(scale(lc_built)),
         lc_wetland              = as.numeric(scale(lc_wetland)),
         lc_cropland             = as.numeric(scale(lc_cropland)))


glm_binom1 <- glm(
  cbind(Number_of_infected_tot_pm, Number_of_participant_tot - Number_of_infected_tot_pm) ~ 1,
  family = "binomial",
  data = sampled_data_join_sf_scale
)

pearson_res1 <- residuals(glm_binom1, type = "pearson")

phi <- sum(pearson_res1^2) / glm_binom1$df.residual

phi


glm_binom2 <- glm(
  cbind(Number_of_infected_tot_pm, Number_of_participant_tot - Number_of_infected_tot_pm) ~
    annual_rainfall_2021 + pop_density_2020 + dist_to_water + lc_trees + annual_temperature_2021 +
    vegetation_index,
  family = "binomial",
  data = sampled_data_join_sf_scale
)

pearson_res2 <- residuals(glm_binom2, type = "pearson")

phi <- sum(pearson_res2^2) / glm_binom2$df.residual

phi
```
- With no covariate, the dispersion coefficient is greater than 6 which is a 
clear sign of over dispersion and even when we add covariate, the coefficient 
is 3.19. Therefore, we will need to use a beta-binomial likelihood in order to
capture all the variation in the observed data.

```{r}
countries3 <- countries3 %>% st_transform(3857)

Africa_union <- st_union(countries3 )

sampled_data_join_sf <- sampled_data_join_sf %>% st_transform(3857)

sampled_data_join_sf_sp     <- as(sampled_data_join_sf, "Spatial")
Africa_union_sp <- as(Africa_union, "Spatial")

coords_Africa <- coordinates(sampled_data_join_sf_sp)


mesh_Africa <- inla.mesh.2d(
  loc      = coords_Africa,
  boundary = inla.sp2segment(Africa_union_sp),
  max.edge = c(50e3, 500e3),   
  cutoff   = 100e3,
  offset   = c(100e3, 1000e3))

# Extract triangle vertex indices
tri <- mesh_Africa$graph$tv


# Build edges from triangles
edges_list <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(tri)) {
  idx <- tri[i, ]
  # Each triangle has 3 edges
  edges_list[[length(edges_list) + 1]] <- st_linestring(mesh_Africa$loc[idx[c(1,2)], 1:2])
  edges_list[[length(edges_list) + 1]] <- st_linestring(mesh_Africa$loc[idx[c(2,3)], 1:2])
  edges_list[[length(edges_list) + 1]] <- st_linestring(mesh_Africa$loc[idx[c(3,1)], 1:2])
}

mesh_edges_sf <- st_as_sf(st_sfc(edges_list, crs = 3857))

coords_df_Africa <- as.data.frame(coords_Africa)
colnames(coords_df_Africa) <- c("X", "Y")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = mesh_edges_sf, fill = NA, color = "grey60", size = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = Africa_union, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = coords_df_Africa, aes(X, Y), color = "red", size = 1.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Mesh for Africa with Boundary")
```

```{r}
spde_Africa <- inla.spde2.pcmatern(
  mesh = mesh_Africa,
  prior.range = c(50e3, 0.5),
  prior.sigma = c(0.2, 0.5))

A_est <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh_Africa, loc = coords_Africa)

#1. Variables to be scale
vars_to_scale <- c("annual_rainfall_2021", "annual_temperature_2021", "lc_trees",
                   "pop_density_2020", "dist_to_water", "vegetation_index")

# 2. Create a named list to store the training parameters (Means and SDs)
scaling_stats <- list()

# 3. Scale the observed data and extract the parameters
for (var in vars_to_scale) {
  # Calculate mean and standard deviation from the 36 observed points
  mean_val <- mean(sampled_data_join_sf[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_val   <- sd(sampled_data_join_sf[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Store them for later use on the grid
  scaling_stats[[var]] <- c(mean = mean_val, sd = sd_val)
  
  # Apply the scaling to the observed data
  sampled_data_join_sf[[var]] <- (sampled_data_join_sf[[var]] - mean_val) / sd_val
}


```


# Model selection via cross-validation

```{r}

nl_vars <- c(
    "annual_rainfall_2021",
    "annual_temperature_2021",
    "dist_to_water",
    "pop_density_2020",
    "vegetation_index",
    "lc_trees")

coords_Africa <- coordinates(sampled_data_join_sf_sp)
sampled_data_join_sf$lon <- coords_Africa[,1]
sampled_data_join_sf$lat <- coords_Africa[,2]
n_nodes <- 5

snap <- function(x, nodes) nodes[max.col(-abs(outer(x, nodes, "-")))]

for (v in nl_vars) {
  nodes <- unique(quantile(sampled_data_join_sf[[v]], probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_nodes), na.rm = TRUE))
  sampled_data_join_sf[[paste0(v, "_id")]] <- snap(sampled_data_join_sf[[v]], nodes)
}

#-----------------------------------------------------------
# BUILD ONE GLOBAL MESH
#-----------------------------------------------------------

mesh <- fmesher::fm_mesh_2d_inla(
  loc = coords_Africa,
  boundary   = fm_as_segm(Africa_union) ,
  max.edge = c(50e3, 500e3),   # inner ~50 km, outer ~500 km
  cutoff   = 100e3,
  offset   = c(100e3, 500e3))




#-----------------------------------------------------------
# DEFINE SPDE MODEL
#-----------------------------------------------------------

spde <- inla.spde2.pcmatern(
  mesh = mesh,
  prior.range = c(50000, 0.5),
  prior.sigma = c(0.2, 0.5))


s.index <- inla.spde.make.index(
  name = "spatial",
  n.spde = spde$n.spde)
#=========================================================
# CANDIDATE MODELS
#=========================================================

candidate_models <- list(

  Model1 = c(
    "annual_rainfall_2021",
    "pop_density_2020",
    "vegetation_index",
    "dist_to_water",
    "lc_trees"),

  Model2 = c(
    "annual_temperature_2021",
    "pop_density_2020",
    "vegetation_index",
    "dist_to_water",
    "lc_trees"))
```

```{r}
make_effects <- function(d, covariates) {
  e <- data.frame(intercept = rep(1, nrow(d)))
  for (v in covariates) {
    e[[v]] <- d[[v]]
    e[[paste0(v, "_id")]] <- d[[paste0(v, "_id")]]
  }
  e
}

make_formula <- function(covariates, type = c("linear", "nonlinear")) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  rhs <- if (type == "linear") {
    paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
  } else {
    paste0("f(", covariates, "_id, model = 'rw2')", collapse = " + ")
  }
  as.formula(paste("y ~ -1 + intercept +", rhs, "+ f(spatial, model = spde)"))
}

fit_full_model <- function(data, covariates, mesh, spde, s.index,
                           type = c("linear", "nonlinear"), model_name = type) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  d <- st_drop_geometry(data)

  A <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh, loc = as.matrix(d[, c("lon", "lat")]))

  stk <- inla.stack(
    data    = list(y = d$Number_of_infected_tot_pf,
                   Ntrials = d$Number_of_participant_tot),
    A       = list(A, 1),
    effects = list(spatial = s.index, make_effects(d, covariates)),
    tag     = "est")

  fit <- inla(make_formula(covariates, type),
              family  = "binomial",
              data    = inla.stack.data(stk),
              Ntrials = inla.stack.data(stk)$Ntrials,
              control.predictor = list(A = inla.stack.A(stk), compute = TRUE),
              control.fixed     = list(mean = 0, prec = 1,
                           mean.intercept = qlogis(0.03)),
              control.compute   = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
              num.threads = "1:1")

  # point wise values (estimation rows only, since this stack has no prediction rows)
  idx    <- inla.stack.index(stk, "est")$data
  waic_i <- fit$waic$local.waic[idx]
  dic_i  <- fit$dic$local.dic[idx]
  lcpo_i <- log(fit$cpo$cpo[idx])
  lcpo_i[fit$cpo$failure[idx] > 0] <- NA        # drop unreliable CPOs

  se_sum  <- function(x) { x <- x[is.finite(x)]; sqrt(length(x) * var(x)) }
  se_mean <- function(x) { x <- x[is.finite(x)]; sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)) }

  summary_tab <- data.frame(
    model  = model_name,
    metric = c("WAIC", "DIC", "LogCPO (mean)"),
    est    = c(fit$waic$waic, fit$dic$dic, mean(lcpo_i, na.rm = TRUE)),
    se     = c(se_sum(waic_i), se_sum(dic_i), se_mean(lcpo_i)))
  summary_tab$lower <- summary_tab$est - 1.96 * summary_tab$se
  summary_tab$upper <- summary_tab$est + 1.96 * summary_tab$se

  list(fit = fit, summary = summary_tab,
       pointwise = data.frame(waic = waic_i, dic = dic_i, lcpo = lcpo_i))
}

# Paired comparison of two models fitted on the same data
# (positive diff in WAIC/DIC => model A is worse; positive in LogCPO => model A is better)
compare_insample <- function(resA, resB) {
  f <- function(x, y) {
    d <- x - y; d <- d[is.finite(d)]
    c(diff = sum(d), se = sqrt(length(d)) * sd(d))
  }
  rbind(WAIC = f(resA$pointwise$waic, resB$pointwise$waic),
        DIC  = f(resA$pointwise$dic,  resB$pointwise$dic),
        LogCPO_sum = f(resA$pointwise$lcpo, resB$pointwise$lcpo))
}
```


```{r}
make_folds <- function(n, K = 3, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  sample(rep(1:K, length.out = n))
}

run_cv <- function(data, covariates, mesh, spde, s.index,
                   type = c("linear", "nonlinear"), model_name = type,
                   folds, S = 100, seed = 123, B = 1000) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  K <- length(unique(folds))
  data$fold   <- folds
  data$obs_id <- seq_len(nrow(data))
  formula <- make_formula(covariates, type)

  fold_results <- list(); pointwise <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(K)) {
    train <- st_drop_geometry(filter(data, fold != i))
    test  <- st_drop_geometry(filter(data, fold == i))

    A_train <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh, loc = as.matrix(train[, c("lon", "lat")]))
    A_test  <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh, loc = as.matrix(test[,  c("lon", "lat")]))

    stack.est <- inla.stack(
      data = list(y = train$Number_of_infected_tot_pm,
                  Ntrials = train$Number_of_participant_tot),
      A = list(A_train, 1),
      effects = list(spatial = s.index, make_effects(train, covariates)), tag = "est")
    stack.pred <- inla.stack(
      data = list(y = NA, Ntrials = test$Number_of_participant_tot),
      A = list(A_test, 1),
      effects = list(spatial = s.index, make_effects(test, covariates)), tag = "pred")
    stk <- inla.stack(stack.est, stack.pred)

    fit <- inla(formula, family = "binomial",
                data = inla.stack.data(stk), Ntrials = inla.stack.data(stk)$Ntrials,
                control.predictor = list(A = inla.stack.A(stk), compute = TRUE, link = 1),
                control.fixed = list(mean = 0, prec = 1,
                           mean.intercept = qlogis(0.3)),
                control.compute = list(config = TRUE),
                num.threads = "1:1",
                control.inla = list(control.vb = list(enable = FALSE)))

    # ---- posterior samples
    idx.pred <- inla.stack.index(stk, "pred")$data
    samples  <- inla.posterior.sample(S, fit, seed = 123L, num.threads = "1:1")
    eta <- inla.posterior.sample.eval(function(idx) APredictor[idx], samples, idx = idx.pred)
    p   <- plogis(eta)                                    # n_test x S

    n <- test$Number_of_participant_tot
    y <- test$Number_of_infected_tot_pm

    # ---- point-prediction metrics
    obs_prev  <- y / n
    pred_mean <- rowMeans(p)

    fold_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
      fold = i,
      RMSE        = sqrt(mean((obs_prev - pred_mean)^2)),
      MAE         = mean(abs(obs_prev - pred_mean)),
      Correlation = cor(obs_prev, pred_mean))

    pointwise[[i]] <- data.frame(obs_id = test$obs_id, fold = i, obs_prev = obs_prev, pred = pred_mean)
  }

  folds_df <- do.call(rbind, fold_results)    # per-fold values (just 2 rows, no CI)
  pw       <- do.call(rbind, pointwise)       # every observation held out exactly once

  # ---- pooled metrics + bootstrap CI over held-out observations
  metrics_fn <- function(d) c(
    RMSE        = sqrt(mean((d$obs_prev - d$pred)^2)),
    MAE         = mean(abs(d$obs_prev - d$pred)),
    Correlation = cor(d$obs_prev, d$pred)
    )

  set.seed(seed)
  est  <- metrics_fn(pw)
  boot <- replicate(B, metrics_fn(pw[sample(nrow(pw), replace = TRUE), ]))

  summary_tab <- data.frame(
    model  = model_name,
    metric = names(est),
    est    = unname(est),
    lower  = apply(boot, 1, quantile, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    upper  = apply(boot, 1, quantile, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    row.names = NULL)

  list(folds = folds_df, pointwise = pw, summary = summary_tab)
}
```


```{r}
full_results <- list()

for (m in names(candidate_models)) {
  for (tp in c("linear", "nonlinear")) {
    nm <- paste(m, tp)
    message("Fitting ", nm)
    full_results[[nm]] <- fit_full_model(
      data       = sampled_data_join_sf,
      covariates = candidate_models[[m]],
      mesh = mesh, spde = spde, s.index = s.index,
      type = tp, model_name = nm)
  }
}

insample_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(full_results, `[[`, "summary"))
insample_tab

folds <- make_folds(nrow(sampled_data_join_sf), K = 3, seed = 123)
cv_results <- list()
for (m in names(candidate_models)) {
  for (tp in c("linear", "nonlinear")) {
    nm <- paste(m, tp)
    message("Fitting ", nm)
    cv_results[[nm]] <- run_cv(
      data       = sampled_data_join_sf,
      covariates = candidate_models[[m]],
      mesh = mesh, spde = spde, s.index = s.index,
      type = tp, model_name = nm,
      folds = folds)
  }
}

cv_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cv_results, `[[`, "summary"))
cv_tab

insample_tab1 <- insample_tab |> select(-se)

result_final <- cv_tab |> 
  bind_rows(insample_tab1)

metrics_select <- c("RMSE", "MAE", "LogCPO (mean)")


result_final1 <- result_final |> 
  filter(metric %in% metrics_select)


higher_better <- c("LogCPO (mean)")

# Identify best model in each metric
result_final2 <- result_final1 %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(Best = if(metric[1] %in% higher_better) {
    est == max(est, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      est == min(est, na.rm = TRUE)
    }) %>%
  arrange(est, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Model_ordered = factor(model, levels = model)) %>%
  ungroup()

Model_selec <- ggplot(result_final2, aes(x = est, y = Model_ordered, colour = Best)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    height = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Model Comparison Forest Plot",
    x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggsave("Outputs/gab_output/Model_selection_criterials_PF.png",
       plot = Model_selec, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
    Ntrials = sampled_data_join_sf$Number_of_participant_tot),
  A = list(A_est, 1),
  effects = list(spatial = 1:spde$n.spde, effects_elevation),
  tag = "est")

formula_elevation <- y ~ 
  -1 +
  intercept +
  elevation + vegetation_index + pop_density_2020 + dist_to_water +
  lc_water + lc_trees + lc_built + lc_cropland + lc_wetland + 
  f(spatial, model = spde)


A_pred <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh = mesh, loc = st_coordinates(grid_sf_africa))

effects_pred <- data.frame(
    intercept               = 1,
    elevation               = grid_sf_africa$elevation,
    vegetation_index        = grid_sf_africa$vegetation_index,
    pop_density_2020        = grid_sf_africa$pop_density_2020,
    dist_to_water           = grid_sf_africa$dist_to_water,
    lc_cropland             = grid_sf_africa$lc_cropland,
    lc_water                = grid_sf_africa$lc_water,
    lc_wetland              = grid_sf_africa$lc_wetland,
    lc_built                = grid_sf_africa$lc_built,
    lc_trees                = grid_sf_africa$lc_trees)

stk_pred <- inla.stack(
    data = list(y = NA, Ntrials = NA),
    A = list(A_pred, 1),
    effects = list(
      spatial = 1:spde$n.spde,
      effects_pred),
    tag = "pred")

stk_full <- inla.stack(stk_est_elevation, stk_pred)
  

res_elevation <- inla(
  formula_elevation,
  family = "betabinomial",
  data = inla.stack.data(stk_full),
  Ntrials = inla.stack.data(stk_full)$Ntrials,
  control.predictor = list(
    A = inla.stack.A(stk_full),
    compute = TRUE,
    link    = 1
  ),
  control.fixed = list(
    mean = 0,
    prec = 0.2
  ),
  control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE,
    config = TRUE)
)


pred_idx <- inla.stack.index(stk_full, "pred")$data

eta_mat <- inla.posterior.sample.eval(
  function() APredictor[pred_idx],
  inla.posterior.sample(100, res_elevation))

prob_mat <- plogis(eta_mat)

pred_mean <- rowMeans(prob_mat)
pred_sd   <- apply(prob_mat, 1, sd)
pred_q05  <- apply(prob_mat, 1, quantile, 0.025)
pred_q95  <- apply(prob_mat, 1, quantile, 0.975)


grid_sf_africa$pred_mean <- pred_mean
grid_sf_africa$pred_sd   <- pred_sd
grid_sf_africa$pred_q05  <- pred_q05
grid_sf_africa$pred_q95  <- pred_q95

res_elevation$summary.fixed

fixed_effects <- data.frame(
  Covariate = rownames(res_elevation$summary.fixed),
  Mean = res_elevation$summary.fixed$mean,
  Lower95 = res_elevation$summary.fixed$`0.025quant`,
  Upper95 = res_elevation$summary.fixed$`0.975quant`
)


Model_selec <- ggplot(fixed_effects, aes(x = Mean, y = Covariate)) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = Lower95, xmax = Upper95),
    height = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             colour = "red",
             linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Model Summary Forest Plot",
    x = "Posterior mean (95% CrI)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

       plot = Model_selec, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#rasterize the predicted prevalence

v1 <- vect(grid_sf_africa)

template <- rast(
  ext = ext(v1),
  resolution = 5000,
  crs = crs(v1))


grid_sf_africa_raster <- rasterize(
  v1,
  template,
  field = c("pred_mean", "pred_q05", "pred_q95"))

terra::plot(grid_sf_africa_raster)
```

```{r}
vect_cmr <- vect(shp_cmr %>% st_transform(3857))
vect_gab <- vect(shp_gab %>% st_transform(3857))
vect_ben <- vect(shp_ben %>% st_transform(3857))
vect_con <- vect(shp_con %>% st_transform(3857))

ben_pr_pm <- crop(grid_sf_africa_raster, vect_ben)
ben_pr_pm <- mask(ben_pr_pm, vect_ben)
ben_pr_pm_df <- terra::extract(ben_pr_pm, vect_ben)
ben_pr_pm_df <- ben_pr_pm_df %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  mutate(pred_mean = mean(pred_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
         pred_q05  = mean(pred_q05, na.rm = TRUE),
         pred_q95  = mean(pred_q95, na.rm = TRUE),
         CI_width  = pred_q95 - pred_q05) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct()

ben_pr_pm_shp <- shp_ben %>% 
  mutate(PmPR     = ben_pr_pm_df$pred_mean,
         PmPR_L   = ben_pr_pm_df$pred_q05,
         PmPR_U   = ben_pr_pm_df$pred_q95,
         CI_width = ben_pr_pm_df$CI_width)
```
